nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.hemodynamics.hemo_viz_io¶

Serialize / reload stage-6 PITC–PWV plot data and Napari geometry.

QC must display the hemodynamics figures and summary values that were written by qvtpy stage 6, not a fresh GUI recompute. When collect_plot_data runs, stage 6 writes hemo_viz_bundle.json next to the CSVs; the GUI loads that bundle (or reconstructs a PITC-only view from the CSVs + saved PNGs).

nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.hemodynamics.hemo_viz_io.load_stage6_hemo_for_qc(stage6_dir: pathlib.Path) → tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], list[nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.hemodynamics.vessel_hemodynamics.RegionGeometryViz], dict[str, pathlib.Path]]¶

Load saved hemodynamics for QC: plot data, geometry list, PNG fallbacks.

Prefers hemo_viz_bundle.json; otherwise reconstructs PITC-only data from CSVs. Callers that need full interactive PWV/station controls should recompute with compute_vessel_hemodynamics() and then apply_saved_hemo_summaries().
